title: 50 storey residential tower, Brisbane CBD: lifts
workplace: 50 storey residential tower with foyer and 3 level basement carpark, Brisbane CBD
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Lift installation in the shafts
swms.task: Install the lift rails and landing doors in the lift shafts, working at the open shaft openings, and lift the lift machines into the motor rooms.

facts.fallControl: Every shaft opening has a fixed barrier until its landing door is installed, and installers in the shaft work from the installation platform with harnesses to engineer rated anchors.

steps: Work at open lift shafts and landing doors
Lift machines, rails and equipment into the shaft

swms.title: Lift car top and pit work, and commissioning
swms.task: Work on the lift car tops and in the lift pits to commission the lifts.

facts.fallControl: The car top has its guardrail fitted before anyone stands on it, and the pit is entered by its fixed ladder.
facts.plantIsolation: For work that does not need the car to move, the lift is isolated at the main switch and locked out with personal padlocks. Where the car must move, it runs only on car top inspection control, operated only by the person doing the work.

steps: Work on the car top and in the pit

rules.phrase: registered before it is commissioned for use
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 231, s 233, s 234, schedule 5
rules.quote: must not commission an item of plant that is stated in schedule 5, part 2 ... unless that item of plant is registered; Nothing in subsection (2) prevents a person from performing any necessary adjustments, tests or inspections as part of the commissioning process

rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 78, s 306E, s 306F
rules.quote: must be made safe immediately after being formed

rules.phrase: Secure barriers stop anyone but the people working in the lift well
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 236
rules.quote: secure barriers are provided to prevent access to openings into the lift well by someone other than a person who is performing work in the lift well

rules.phrase: a written entry permit from a competent person
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 66, s 67, s 69
rules.quote: A confined space entry permit must (a) be completed by a competent person; and (b) be in writing
